IndiGo Flight Diverted to Hyderabad After Power Bank Fire

An IndiGo flight traveling from Delhi to Chennai was diverted to Hyderabad on Sunday after a passenger's power bank caught fire mid-air, emitting smoke. The incident led to an emergency landing in Hyderabad, where the aircraft landed safely. The fire originated from a power bank in a passenger's luggage.
